text: A black monolith, warm to the touch. Glyphs crawl across its face, glowing the color of deep water.
You can't read them. And yet, as you look, the meaning settles into you like silt:
"WE PASSED THIS WAY AND THE WATERS FOLLOWED. SEEK THE STONE WHERE THE SUN DROWNS."
The glow pulses once, as if something far away noticed.
"SEEK THE STONE WHERE THE SUN DROWNS."
The glyphs hum faintly. Somewhere to the west, perhaps.
